title: Skill tree - House of Pips Wiki
description: Every House of Pips skill on the Table Sense, Fortune and House Rules tabs.
html:
Skill tree

The skill tree holds your permanent career upgrades. Unlike perks, skills stay with you from match to match. Every career level you gain gives you one skill point, and each point buys one rank of one skill. The tree has 42 ranks in total across three tabs:

Table Sense
8 skills · see the tab
Fortune
7 skills · see the tab
House Rules
3 skills · see the tab

How the tree works:

  • A skill unlocks once the skill above it reaches the rank shown on the line between them (a small R2 tag means rank 2 is needed). The top skill on each tab is available straight away.
  • Skills with several ranks get stronger with each point you spend.
  • Respec refunds every point you spent for 2000 Bone Bucks, or for free if you have a free respec from the Slap Track.
  • Old School turns skills off. Online matches use a separate skill build; see Online play.
  • Skills are not perks: they don't count as perk bonuses for Midas Touch, Echo Chamber or Perk Tax.

Table Sense

End Count

Table Sense · up to rank 1

Reveal the current total of every exposed end during play.

In-game text

Shows the current total of all open ends on the table at all times, so you can see at a glance how far you are from the next multiple of five.

Requires: Nothing: it is a starting skill on this tab.

Reader's Eye

Table Sense · up to rank 1

Highlight every bone in your hand that can be played.

In-game text

Every bone in your rack that can be played right now is highlighted, so you never have to hunt for a legal play.

Requires: End Count rank 1.

Landing Lights

Table Sense · up to rank 1

Make valid gray drop boxes glow when you select a bone.

In-game text

When you pick up a bone, every valid drop box for it glows. Drop boxes that need the bone rotated are marked "Rotate to play".

Requires: Reader's Eye rank 1.

Fiver Sense

Table Sense · up to rank 1

Scoring play locations flare pink before you commit.

In-game text

When you pick up a bone, the places where it would score flare pink before you commit, and the tooltip shows the base score.

Requires: Landing Lights rank 1.

Pip Forecast

Table Sense · up to rank 1

Show projected open-end totals before you commit a play.

In-game text

Hovering a place to play shows the open-end total the table would have after that play, even when it would not score. Compact number badges sit beside the landing previews, with one Projected totals caption in the status column. The bones stay visible; a crowded table keeps the forecast available in the landing tooltip.

Requires: Fiver Sense rank 1.

Bone Memory

Table Sense · up to rank 1

Count how many unplayed bones outside your rack contain each pip, including public bones Rival still holds.

In-game text

Shows, for each number from 0 to 6, how many bones you haven't seen played yet contain that number: bones in Rival's rack and in the boneyard. Bones Rival has revealed are included.

  • It is a counting aid: it never shows where a bone is.

Requires: End Count rank 1.

Branch Reader

Table Sense · up to rank 3

Hover plays for follow-up counts. Rank 1 marks the best location. Rank 2 labels its count. Rank 3 also marks your best hand bone blue; scoring breaks ties.

In-game text

Hovering a place to play shows how many follow-up plays your rack would have afterwards.

  • Rank 1 marks the location that leaves you the most follow-ups.
  • Rank 2 also labels that count on the board.
  • Rank 3 also marks your best bone to play in blue. When two options are tied, the one that scores wins.

Requires: Pip Forecast rank 1.

Coffin Corner

Table Sense · up to rank 3

A scoring play that fills the fourth side of a spinner gains 10 points per rank.

In-game text

A scoring play that fills the fourth and last side of a spinner gains +10 points per rank.

  • The bonus is added after maluses, and only if the play still scores.
  • It is a skill bonus, so Midas Touch doesn't double it.

Requires: Branch Reader rank 2.

Fortune

Loaded Luck

Fortune · up to rank 5

Increase the relative odds of uncommon or better perks by 12% per rank.

In-game text

Raises the relative odds of Uncommon, Rare, Epic and Legendary cards in your perk drafts by 12% per rank. Commons become correspondingly less frequent.

  • Legendary perks still only appear once you have unlocked them.

Requires: Nothing: it is a starting skill on this tab.

Gilded Draw

Fortune · up to rank 3

Further increase rare and epic perk odds by 15% per rank.

In-game text

Raises the relative odds of Rare, Epic and Legendary cards by a further 15% per rank, on top of Loaded Luck.

Requires: Loaded Luck rank 2.

Golden Thread

Fortune · up to rank 3

Further increase unlocked legendary perk odds by 25% per rank.

In-game text

Raises the relative odds of Legendary cards by a further 25% per rank. It only affects legendary perks you have already unlocked.

Requires: Gilded Draw rank 2.

Cut Again

Fortune · up to rank 3

Gain one free perk-card reroll in every draft per rank.

In-game text

Gives you one free reroll per rank in every draft. A reroll replaces one positive card with a fresh card; the Malus card can't be rerolled.

  • Rerolls are not offered in All In or Legendary Table drafts, or after you reserve a card with Fortune Mortgage.

Requires: Loaded Luck rank 1.

Lucky Recovery

Fortune · up to rank 3

Each consecutive hand loss boosts uncommon-or-better draft weight by 25% per rank, up to three losses.

In-game text

Each hand you lose in a row (up to three) raises the relative odds of Uncommon or better cards in your next draft by 25% per rank. The draft screen shows the current boost. Winning a hand resets the streak.

Requires: Loaded Luck rank 2.

Perk Echo

Fortune · up to rank 3

New perks have a 10% chance per rank to echo as a second copy for the next hand.

In-game text

Every time you gain a new positive perk, there is a 10% chance per rank that it echoes: you get a temporary second copy for the next hand, which disappears after that hand.

Requires: Lucky Recovery rank 1.

Fortune Mortgage

Fortune · up to rank 3

Reserve one perk offer for your next eligible draft, then take another perk offer now. Gain one use per match per rank.

In-game text

In a standard draft, reserve one positive card for later, then choose another card from the same offer now. The reserved perk comes back as the first card of your next eligible draft.

  • Each rank gives one use per match.
  • After reserving, you must finish the draft with a different positive card: not the Malus, and not Take all.
  • Legendary Table drafts never bring a reserved card back.

Requires: Cut Again rank 2.

House Rules

No Half Measures

House Rules · up to rank 1

Take every offered perk and the Malus instead of choosing one card.

In-game text

Adds a Take all choice to standard drafts: you take every positive card and the Malus instead of one card.

  • It is not available in Legendary Table drafts or after you reserve a card with Fortune Mortgage. All In matches always take everything.

Requires: Nothing: it is a starting skill on this tab.

House Favor

House Rules · up to rank 3

Gain a 10% chance per rank to begin a run with a bonus common perk.

In-game text

At the start of a match, there is a 10% chance per rank (up to 30%) that you begin with a bonus Common perk, chosen at random from the commons you have unlocked.

Requires: No Half Measures rank 1.

Malus Ward

House Rules · up to rank 3

Automatically block the first triggered malus. Rank 1 works once per match; ranks 2 and 3 recharge after four and two hands.

In-game text

Automatically blocks the first malus that would affect you, then needs to recharge.

  • Rank 1: blocks once per match.
  • Rank 2: recharges four hands after it blocks something.
  • Rank 3: recharges two hands after it blocks something.
  • It can block Greedy Draw, Leaky Pocket, Stumble, Cracked Doubles, Five Jinx, Perk Tax, Heavy Hand and Exposed Hand. It can't block Bone Anchor, which limits which bones you may play rather than costing you points.
  • On a scoring play it blocks only the first malus that would take points off; any others still apply. The table shows "MALUS WARD READY" while it is charged.

Requires: House Favor rank 2.
